**East grew most** — from 5 to 12, a gain of **+7 units (+140%)**, the largest in both absolute and percentage terms.

| Region | Q1 | Q2 | Growth | Growth % |
|--------|----|----|--------|----------|
| **East** | 5 | 12 | **+7** | **+140%** |
| North | 10 | 15 | +5 | +50% |
| South | 20 | 19 | −1 | −5% |

Note the flip side: South is the biggest region but the only one that shrank. Want a bar chart of this, or a deeper look (e.g., if you have more quarters to add)?
